name: Ogata Akira
source:
Although he's quick to anger, it's hard to anger him to a crucial point. He's bad at studying and has a bad attitude, but he's also compassionate and easily deceived.

[Translated from [url=http://tennenouji.net/product/01_noten/01char.html]official website[/url]]
